doNotRemoveTestData.description: Whether or not to remove all data before loading test data.

doNotPersistFiles.description: Flag indiciating whether or not to persist the created files

doNotConnectAssets.description: Flag inidicating whether or not to connect assets to diagrams

doNotVerifySensors.description: Flag indicating whether or not to verify {@link ParsedSensor}s

doNotCollideSensors.description: Flag indicating whether or not to collide {@link ParsedSensor}s

doNotNullifySensors.description: Flag indicating whether or not to have {@link ParsedSensor#actualSensor}s

runParseAndMatchWorkflow.description:
Flag indicating whether to run the {@link DiagramParsingMatchingHelper#parseAndMatchBatch} on test files.
Setting this flag to true,
 - Uploads 'test/resource/diagrams.pdf' repeatedly {@link #numFiles} number of times.
 - Uploads {@link Sensor}s as target sensors to be matched.
 - Runs {@link SourceParsableDiagram#triggerBatchParseAndMatchWorkflowOnFormSubmit} on the urls.

**NOTE: **Setting this flag to true, will not respect any other options except for `numFiles`; the entire test data will be created as result of real parsing workflows.
The parsing workflow runs asynchronously and the status can be monitored via the corresponding {@link UploadedFileCollection#getParsingStatus}.
Expect {@link ParsedSensor}s and {@link ParsableDiagram}s to be populated once the parsing workflow has 'Completed' and
the {@link ActionQueue action} and {@link WorkflowQueue workflow} queues have been processed.

numFiles.description: Number of P&ID source files to be created

diagramsPerFile.description: Number of {@link ParsableDiagram}s per source file to be created

numPhysicalAssets.description: Number of {@link PhysicalAsset} to be linked to {@link ParsableDiagram}

sensorRangePerDiagram.description:
Range of number of {@link ParsedSensor}s per {@link ParsableDiagram} to be created
Is an array of two numbers representing the minimum and maximum

numUploadJobs.description: Number of {@link ParsedSensor}s per {@link ParsableDiagram} to be created

percentVerifiedSensors.description: Percentage of all created {@link ParsedSensor}s to be verified

percentWithNoSensors.description: Percentage of all created {@link ParsedSensor}s  to have no {@link ParsedSensor#actualSensor}

percentCollidingSensors.description:
Percentage of created {@link ParsedSensor}s to point to same {@link ParsedSensor#actualSensor}s

Overview of logic used to make them collide.
For example, If you want 5% of 2000 which is, 100 parsed sensors collide,
These are split into two sets of 50 parsed sensors in which like:
SET 1: ['PS001', 'PS002', 'PS003', ....]
SET 2: ['PS051', 'PS052', 'PS053', ....]
['PS001', 'PS051'] & ['PS002', 'PS052'] & ['PS003', 'PS053'] point to same actual sensors
